card.name: Ampersand between citation author names
card.fires_on: The ampersand "&" joining two authors' surnames or initials in academic citations and reference lists, just before the second author's name.

modes.label: Reference list entries
modes.description: Ampersand between authors in a bibliography entry, often after initials.
modes.example: Burke, L.<< &>> Sugg, Z. Hydrologic Modeling

modes.label: In-text citations
modes.description: Ampersand between two surnames inside parentheses before a year.

card.writes: It seems to promote the start of a second author's surname, such as word-start pieces like "hem" or "ween".
card.plain: It marks the "&" between two authors' names in a reference or citation.
